name: Server Analysis: weu-ai-test
description: Полный анализ сервера weu-ai-test: пакеты для обновления и системные логи

steps.title: Анализ пакетов для обновления
steps.prompt: Execute via server_execute on weu-ai-test. Run commands to list upgradable packages (apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null or yum check-update). Show count and list of packages. Output <promise>STEP_DONE</promise> when done

steps.title: Анализ системных логов
steps.prompt: Execute via server_execute on weu-ai-test. Run journalctl -n 100 --no-pager, dmesg | tail -50, and check /var/log for recent errors. Summarize findings. Output <promise>STEP_DONE</promise> when done
